title: contactPrimitivesShowcase.py revised: a visible ground, moving rings and bearing, a richer polytope, a scene for the raytracer
author: Claude-JG
description: In contactPrimitivesShowcase.py the floor and the inclined plane are not drawn, so the bodies roll in space; the shaft starts inside the ring and hardly moves; the journal bearing is a tiny disc at rest; the polytope is a cube; the contact shapes are drawn with a fine tiling. Decided: the ground drawn, the ring contact and the bearing large enough to see what they do, a polytope with more faces, shadows and settings for a raytraced picture.
releaseNotes: contactPrimitivesShowcase.py shows the contacts between primitive shapes on a drawn floor: a ball over a cylinder, a roller down a ramp, a rolling cone, an icosahedron tumbling into a cube, a ring swinging on a shaft and a rotor floating in a journal bearing, with the contact forces as arrows, shadows and a switch for a raytraced picture.
